stages.name: Tide Pool
stages.blurb: The King needs a small sticky star. Roll the shallows.
stages.kingIntro: Small work for a small Prince. Do not be offended. Be useful.
kingPraise: Hmm! Sticky, round, and faintly fishy. Perfect. Hang it in the sky!
A petite little blob. Not royal, exactly, but charming in a damp way.
Yes, yes. The shallows are less embarrassing now.
kingFailure: Tiny! Minuscule! We have seen plankton with greater ambition.
The Cosmos cannot hang a shrug in the sky. Roll larger.
A damp marble is not a star, little Prince.

stages.name: Coral Reef
stages.blurb: Bigger waters. Bigger ambitions. Make a proper reef-star.
stages.kingIntro: Now the reef. Colorful, crowded, and terribly under-rolled.
kingPraise: Magnificent lump! The cosmos looks slightly more... moist. I approve.
Ah! A reef-star. Gaudy, sticky, almost fashionable.
The corals tremble. The King nods. This is progress.
kingFailure: A reef requires volume, not optimism.
You rolled with feeling, but not enough circumference.
Pretty colors, little result. The King sighs beautifully.

stages.name: Beach Town
stages.blurb: Umbrellas, towels, and tourist clutter. Roll the shoreline.
stages.kingIntro: Mortals leave nonsense on the sand. Harvest it. Beautifully.
kingPraise: A sunburnt sphere of vacation debris! The cosmos is now on holiday.
Sticky, sandy, faintly coconut-scented. Hang it with pride!
The beach is cleaner. The King is smug. Perfect.
kingFailure: Still beach-ball sized. The King expected a town-ball.
Umbrellas remain upright. That is a personal insult.
Too small to cast shade. Try again, damp Prince.

stages.name: Crab Hunt
stages.blurb: A special request: scoop crabs. Size is optional. Crabs are not.
stages.kingIntro: Forget size. Fetch crabs. Exactly the royal number. Do not ask why.
kingPraise: Crabs! A scurrying constellation! The King is inexplicably delighted.
Yes! Crab after crab after crab. Astronomy has never been so sideways.
A sticky bouquet of claws. Hang it carefully — they pinch.
kingFailure: Insufficient crabs. The Cosmos cannot accept excuses.
You rolled past them. They noticed. The King noticed.
Crab count: disappointing. Ambition: also crabs.

stages.name: Harbor
stages.blurb: Roll the docks. Leave no buoy un-scooped.
stages.kingIntro: The harbor is cluttered with mortal nonsense. Convert it to astronomy.
kingPraise: A lighthouse of junk! Truly, my child, you understand stickiness.
Splendid! We can smell the dock from here. Very celestial.
Boats, buoys, barnacles of destiny. Into the sky with it!
kingFailure: No beacon today. Merely a floating disappointment.
The King expected grandeur. The Prince delivered a beach toy.

stages.name: Boardwalk
stages.blurb: Carnival clutter and pier junk. Roll until the lights look tiny.
stages.kingIntro: The boardwalk glitters with mortal frivolity. Absorb the frivolity.
kingPraise: A carnival moon! Sticky, loud, and slightly sticky with cotton candy.
The pier has been promoted to orbit. The King applauds slowly.
Grand! A prism of junk-food destiny. Hang it high!
kingFailure: Still carnival-snack sized. Grow into the rides.
The boardwalk laughs at your circumference.
Not prismatic enough. Roll harder, Prince of Midway.
